all_bands.meaning: The explicit comoving correction has negligible effect on all seven band ratios; the direct/recovered velocity choice is further erased by band integration.

interpretation: The remaining extreme cross-code discrepancy cannot be assigned to the former direct comparison of CLASS comoving d_m with CAMB synchronous delta_tot. Recombination, perturbation implementation, phase sampling and other systematics must be investigated separately.
verification: Independent reconstruction and highest-band recomputation passed for 6 sources and 3 methods; all 24 zero-model Python tests and the full platform test/build suite passed.
boundaries: This is a fixed-input numerical comparison, not an observational fit or model-family exclusion.
No joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, parameter search, or likelihood covariance is included.
All previous gauge, interpolation and frozen-power evidence remains unchanged.
